gazette_location.description_raw_en: Thoroughfare as shown coloured grey on Drawing No. KH 3445A commencing at Kai Shing House to run eastwards for about 240 m, then turning south-easterly for about 140 m before changing to run south-westerly for about 100 m and further extending in the west direction for about 30 m to its termination near Kai Hong House.
gazette_location.description_raw_zh: 此街道之位置，在 KH 3445A 號圖則上以灰色標明。起點在啟盛樓，向東伸展約240米，再轉向東南伸展約140米，然後改向西南伸展約100米，再續向西伸展約30米，至啟康樓附近終止。

gazette_location.description_raw_en: Cul-de-sac as shown coloured grey on Drawing No. KH 3737 commencing at its junction with Lei Yue Mun Road running southwestwards for 170 m then southeastwards for another 170 m before going southwestwards again for 30 m to terminate at the entrance gate of Margaret Trench Medical Rehabilitation Centre.
gazette_location.description_raw_zh: 此盡頭路之位置，在 KH 3737 號圖則上以灰色標明。起點與鯉魚門道連接，向西南伸展約170米，再轉向東南伸展約170米，然後改向西南伸展30米，至戴麟趾夫人復康院正門處終止。
